blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. Every work day needs a short, honest report at the end.

Today we use was and were, the past of to be. We use them to say how the day went. "Was" is for I, he, she, and it. "Were" is for you, we, and they.

Clear past reports are the base of every good routine. They help the team see the good days and fix the hard ones. So we celebrate the good days — they pay for the hard ones.

items.q: What does the team make at the end of every work day?
options: A new plan for next year
A phone call to a client
items.why: "Every work day needs a short, honest report at the end."

items.q: Which words are the past of "to be"?
items.why: O texto diz que usamos "was" e "were", o passado de "to be".

items.q: You use "were" with…
items.why: "'Were' is for you, we, and they."

items.q: The text suggests that a good report is…
items.why: Inferência: o texto pede um relatório "short, honest" a cada dia — não longo, nem mensal.

items.q: "They pay for the hard ones" suggests that the good days…
options: make the hard days feel worth it
items.why: Inferência: comemorar os bons dias compensa e dá força para os dias difíceis.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emily contar para o time como foi o dia de ontem. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi team, here is a short report about yesterday. It was a good day. I am happy.

The plan was thirty deliveries. In the end, we had thirty-two. That was great. The drivers were on time in the morning. The first trip was fast and easy.

In the afternoon, two trips were late. The traffic was very bad near the port. But the clients were kind. They were not angry. One client was very happy with the driver. She sent a nice message to the boss.

So, was it a perfect day? No, it was not perfect. But it was a good day. The team was strong, and the mood was positive. Thank you all. Tomorrow we try again. Good night.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many deliveries were planned for yesterday?
items.why: "The plan was thirty deliveries."

items.q: What happened in the afternoon?
options: All the trips were on time
items.why: "In the afternoon, two trips were late."

items.q: How were the clients?
items.why: "the clients were kind. They were not angry."

items.q: Emily says it was not a perfect day. This suggests that…
options: the day was a total failure
she is honest about the problems
she wants to quit her job
items.why: Inferência: ela admite os atrasos, mas ainda chama o dia de bom — é um relatório honesto.

items.q: How does Emily feel about the team?
items.why: Inferência: "The team was strong, and the mood was positive. Thank you all."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We had thirty-two deliveries yesterday." Yesterday means…
items.why: Yesterday = ontem, o dia antes de hoje.

items.q: "The first trip was fast and easy." A trip is…
options: a journey from one place to another
items.why: Trip = viagem, o trajeto do carro de um lugar a outro.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "At the end of the day, Emily sends a short ___ to the team."
items.why: Report = relatório, o resumo do dia que ela envia.

items.q: "She sent a nice message to the boss." The boss is…
options: the person who leads the team
items.why: Boss = chefe, a pessoa que lidera o time.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "One ___ was very happy with the delivery."
items.why: Client = cliente, quem recebe a entrega.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The drivers were on time in the morning." To be on time means to…
items.why: On time = na hora certa, nem cedo nem tarde.

items.q: "Tomorrow we try again." To try again means to…
items.why: Try again = tentar de novo, mais uma vez.

items.q: "The client was happy with the driver." To be happy with something means to…
items.why: Happy with = satisfeito, contente com algo.

items.q: "The traffic was bad, so two trips ran late." To run late means to…
items.why: Run late = atrasar, chegar mais tarde do que o planejado.

items.q: "At the end of the shift, Emily sums up the day." To sum up means to…
items.why: Sum up = resumir, dar um resumo curto.
